message: Here's a good radio station if you get your broadband going: kexp.org. I think you'll like it. Is local NPR online? Even in Spokane we get it online, so I'm guessing West Point and environs must as well. If not, kpbx.org. Good luck settling in. I guess that means the contractors are gone. I wish ours would finish and leave for good, rather than just disappearing for days at a time.
